mapper.select: SELECT a.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, a.EMAIL, a.PHONE_NUMBER, a.ACCOUNT_ROLE, a.SOCIAL_TYPE, a.REG_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEWS WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_EVENTS WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID) AS EVENT_COUNT FROM ACCOUNT_TBL a WHERE a.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT_TBL
AND (ACCOUNT_ID LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR ACCOUNT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, r.PLACE_ID, r.PLACE_TYPE, CASE WHEN r.PLACE_TYPE = 'FOOD' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM RESTAURANTS_DETAIL WHERE ID = r.PLACE_ID) WHEN r.PLACE_TYPE = 'STAY' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM STAY_DETAIL WHERE CONTENT_ID = r.PLACE_ID) WHEN r.PLACE_TYPE = 'TOUR' THEN (SELECT TITLE FROM TOUR_SPOTS WHERE SPOT_ID = TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE(r.PLACE_ID, '[^0-9]', ''))) ELSE r.PLACE_ID END AS PLACE_NAME, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEWS r INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON r.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE r.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEWS r INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON r.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID
AND (r.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR a.ACCOUNT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR r.PLACE_ID LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT_TBL) AS TOTAL_USERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEWS) AS TOTAL_REVIEWS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_EVENTS) AS TOTAL_EVENTS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT_TBL WHERE TRUNC(REG_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS TODAY_NEW_USERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEWS WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS TODAY_NEW_REVIEWS, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ACCOUNT_ID) FROM REVIEWS WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30) AS ACTIVE_USERS FROM DUAL

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.DATE_VAL, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DATE_STR, NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACCOUNT_TBL WHERE TRUNC(REG_DATE) = d.DATE_VAL), 0) AS NEW_USERS, NVL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEWS WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = d.DATE_VAL), 0) AS NEW_REVIEWS FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - LEVEL + 1 AS DATE_VAL FROM DUAL START WITH 1 = 1 CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{days} ) d ORDER BY DATE_STR
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PLACE_ID, PLACE_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEWS GROUP BY PLACE_ID, PLACE_TYPE ORDER BY REVIEW_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEWS r INNER JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON r.ACCOUNT_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID GROUP BY r.ACCOUNT_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME ORDER BY REVIEW_COUNT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID, i.WRITER_ID, w.ACCOUNT_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, i.TITLE, i.CONTENT, i.ANSWER_CONTENT, i.ANSWERER_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME AS ANSWERER_NAME, i.STATUS, i.CREATED_DATE, i.ANSWERED_DATE FROM INQUIRIES i LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL w ON i.WRITER_ID = w.ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON i.ANSWERER_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE i.INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}

SELECT i.INQUIRY_ID, i.WRITER_ID, w.ACCOUNT_NAME AS WRITER_NAME, i.TITLE, i.CONTENT, i.ANSWER_CONTENT, i.ANSWERER_ID, a.ACCOUNT_NAME AS ANSWERER_NAME, i.STATUS, i.CREATED_DATE, i.ANSWERED_DATE FROM INQUIRIES i LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL w ON i.WRITER_ID = w.ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_TBL a ON i.ANSWERER_ID = a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE i.WRITER_ID = #{writerId} ORDER BY i.CREATED_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE INQUIRIES SET ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, ANSWERER_ID = #{answererId}, ANSWERED_DATE = SYSDATE, STATUS = 'ANSWERED' WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INQUIRIES ( INQUIRY_ID, WRITER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, STATUS, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_INQUIRY_ID.NEXTVAL, #{writerId}, #{title}, #{content}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
